description: Durable session position, unattended plan execution, and cross-engine adversarial review.

interface.longDescription: Durable session position for any repository: /status, /next, /auto, /handoff, and /adversarial. Works unconfigured by reading markdown checkboxes; projects shape behaviour through .agent/config.json and .agent/rules.md.
